references.text: The same pattern where Balaam tells Balak to stand by the burnt offering while he goes off to meet God. Shows the repeated ritual in Balaam's prophetic practice.
Balaam returns to Balak, who is standing by his burnt offering, parallel to the situation in verse 15.
The background for the burnt offerings that Balak sacrificed: seven altars with seven bulls and seven rams.
The immediately preceding verse describing the seven altars and sacrifices prepared before Balaam gives his instruction in verse 15.
On the third attempt, Balaam changes his approach and no longer seeks signs as before, which contrasts with the pattern in 23:15.
